LanguageData.TKKN_NPS_MustPlaceOnSteamVent: You must place this on a steam vent
LanguageData.NPS_AllowBiomes_Text: Allow {0} to spawn during world generation
LanguageData.NPS_ModifyBiome_Text: Modifies generation of the {0} biome to use different logic
LanguageData.NPS_Dandelions_Text: Changes dandelions to generate wild greens when fully grown.
LanguageData.NPS_WildVegetables_Text: Wild vegetable plants will generate in biomes
LanguageData.NPS_GrassTexture_Text: Replaces the textures for Grass and Long Grass and adds an extra variant to them.
LanguageData.NPS_LavaReplace_Text: Replace the lava that spawns on the Volcanic fields biome with its Odyssey counterpart
LanguageData.NPS_SteamVentsDespawn_Text: Steam vents can despawn. These will occasionally respawn as well
LanguageData.NPS_SpawnNote: Although these affect the spawn chances, the actual calculations can not be modified. This can cause adverse effects. Try using a mod like "Choose Biome Commonality" for more fine-tuning.
